name: Fathom
description: Fathom (fathom.video) is an AI meeting recorder whose API exposes meeting summaries, transcripts and action items.
auth_notes: SDKs authenticate with API keys created at user level; public OAuth apps require registering an app with Fathom first.
gate_detail: Docs say anyone can start building and API keys are created per user. Sources do not state whether a free plan suffices. Public OAuth apps need registration; marketplace listing is for partners. Rate limit 60 calls per minute.
api_scope: Meetings list, summaries, transcripts and recording downloads, plus webhooks; TypeScript and Python SDKs.
mcp_notes: Vendor developer docs include an MCP section and MCP Setup pages; no server URL given in the sources.
blocker_detail: Plan requirement for API key creation is not stated; OAuth app registration needed only for public integrations.

evidence.quote: Authenticate with the Fathom SDKs using API keys
OAuth users need to register an app with us before using this feature.
Anyone can browse the API docs and start building!
API keys are created at the user level. Your key can access meetings recorded by you or shared to your Team.
Call POST /recordings/{recording_id}/download to start generating a downloadable file
Create one in User Settings → API Access → Manage → Add Webhook (or via the API).
